details: The agent successfully visited all three required sites and produced accurate results: (1) Wikipedia - correctly identified Graydon Hoare as the designer of Rust; (2) GitHub - correctly reported 112k stars (100k+); (3) rust-lang.org - correctly retrieved the tagline 'A language empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.' All three sites were actually navigated to as evidenced by the browser commands and their outputs.
